college_identity.title: College identity and location
college_identity.answer: Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKR Engineering College) is located at SRKR Marg, China Amiram, Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh, India - 534204. The college profile states that it was founded in 1980. The official site describes it as an autonomous institution and lists NAAC A+ accreditation. Confirm current accreditation/programme status on the official website before relying on time-sensitive claims.

campus_overview.title: Campus overview
campus_overview.answer: The college profile describes a 30-acre campus in Bhimavaram. The external Mapcarta/OpenStreetMap map identifies the college boundary and nearby mapped features including the Ground/Pitch, SRKR Pond, CIVIL DEPARTMENT, N Block, Silver Jubilee Block and WET Centre. The map is not a complete official building directory and does not establish classroom numbers, internal corridors or exact room locations.

campus_map_locations.title: Map-listed campus locations
campus_map_locations.answer: The campus map currently labels CIVIL DEPARTMENT, N Block, Silver Jubilee Block, WET Centre, Ground/Pitch and SRKR Pond. If asked for a location not shown on the map, say that the public map does not provide enough verified detail and direct the user to the college office or the relevant department. Never invent a block-to-department mapping or room number.

programmes_ug.title: Undergraduate programmes
programmes_ug.answer: The official programmes page lists undergraduate offerings in AI & Data Science, AI & ML, Civil Engineering, CS & Business System, CS & Design, CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Mechanical, CIC, CS & IT, and BBA. Programme names and availability can change; check the current official programmes/admissions pages for the active intake.

programmes_pg.title: Postgraduate programmes
programmes_pg.answer: The official programmes page lists postgraduate specializations including CAD/CAM, Structural Engineering, Communication Systems, Computer Science and Technology, Information Technology, Power Systems and Automation, Electric Vehicle Technology, and Artificial Intelligence. Confirm the current intake and specialization availability with the official admissions page.

programmes_phd.title: PhD programmes
programmes_phd.answer: The official programmes page lists PhD areas in Civil Engineering, CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and English. Contact the college research office for current admission notifications, eligibility and supervisor availability.

syllabus_regulations.title: Syllabus and regulations directory
syllabus_regulations.answer: SRKR's official syllabus directory is organized by regulation. It currently lists R26 B.Tech first-year syllabus/model papers across the listed branches; R25 M.Tech specialization syllabus/model papers; R24 BBA first, second and third year; R23 B.Tech first through fourth year across the listed branches plus open electives, Honours, Minors and model papers; R20 B.Tech year-wise resources; and older R19, R17 and R16 resources. Students must select the regulation applicable to their admission batch.

syllabus_lookup_requirements.title: Information needed for an exact syllabus answer
syllabus_lookup_requirements.answer: To identify the correct subject list or syllabus, the chatbot should ask for four details: degree/programme, branch or specialization, regulation (for example R23 or R20), and year/semester. If the user does not know the regulation, ask for their admission year and advise them to verify the assigned regulation from college records. Do not infer a regulation from the current year.

model_papers.title: Model question papers
model_papers.answer: The official syllabus directory provides model-paper links alongside many regulation, branch and year syllabus entries. The chatbot should direct users to the matching regulation, branch and year on the official directory rather than supplying an unrelated paper.

open_electives_honours_minors.title: Open electives, Honours and Minors
open_electives_honours_minors.answer: The R23 directory includes Open Electives I-IV and Honours/Minor resources. The R20 directory also lists Open Electives, Honours and Minors. Availability and eligibility should be checked against the student's own regulation and official academic instructions.

departments_and_programme_coordinators.title: Departments and programme coordination
departments_and_programme_coordinators.answer: The official leadership page lists department heads and programme coordinators for several departments/programmes, including Civil, CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, IT, Management Studies, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, English, CS & IT, AI & ML, AI & Data Science, CS & Business System, CSE-IoT & Cyber Security and CS & Design. Names and assignments may change; use the live leadership page for current contacts.

hostel_overview.title: Hostel facilities
hostel_overview.answer: SRKR's official hostel page describes on-campus hostel accommodation, wardens, student support and medical/essential assistance. It mentions access to gymnasium, playground and indoor gaming facilities, and states that the college follows a no-ragging ethos. Room availability, fees, rules, mess timings and admission procedures should be confirmed with the hostel office.

hostel_contacts.title: Hostel office contacts
hostel_contacts.answer: The official hostel page lists the Chief Warden contact as 8074874235, Boys Hostel as 9492123311, Girls Hostel as 7995383711 and email hostels@srkrec.ac.in. Since contact details can change, verify on the live hostel page before use.

library.title: Central library
library.answer: The official library page describes a 4,160-square-metre automated library with RFID technology, more than 24,000 titles, about 1.19 lakh volumes, 6,458 e-journals and 110 print journals. Facilities include a Digital Learning Centre with 252 systems, e-learning, reading room, book bank and reference section. The page lists e-resources and databases including ScienceDirect, ASCE Library, IEEE Xplore, Springer, DELNET, J-Gate, N-LIST, NPTEL and Knimbus. Some e-journals are stated to be accessible through the campus LAN.

library_opac.title: Library OPAC
library_opac.answer: The library page links to an OPAC through which users can search the catalogue and check real-time book and asset availability. Use the OPAC link on the official library page.

transport.title: College transportation
transport.answer: The official transportation page says college buses connect students and staff from Bhimavaram and surrounding towns, including rural and urban areas. It describes multiple routes, high-capacity buses, comfortable seating, safety and punctuality. It does not provide a static complete route/time table in the extracted page content, so users should contact the Transport Section for current routes, stops, fees and timings.

transport_contacts.title: Transport office contact
transport_contacts.answer: The official transportation page lists the Transport Section in the Admin Block, SRKR Engineering College, Bhimavaram; phone +91 884 222 6666; email transport@srkrec.ac.in. Verify the live page for updates.

placements_overview.title: Training and placement cell
placements_overview.answer: SRKR has a Training & Placement team with officers, faculty coordinators and department representatives. The official team page publishes placement statistics, recruiter information and department-wise coordinators. Placement percentages, offers and salary figures are batch-specific and must be quoted with their reporting year; they are not guarantees for an individual student.

placements_contact.title: Placement cell contact
placements_contact.answer: The official placements team page lists the Dean of Placements & Industry Relations contact as krsn@srkrec.ac.in and 9704195376. It lists the Training & Placement office at U Block, SRKR Engineering College, Bhimavaram - 534204, with office hours Monday-Saturday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM. Verify the live page before contacting.

placement_statistics.title: Published placement statistics
placement_statistics.answer: The current official placements team page displays 87.3% placements for 2025-26, a 19.00 LPA top package attributed to AT&T, 79 on-campus recruiters and 15 industry partners. Treat these as the website's published figures for the stated reporting period, not as guaranteed outcomes or lifetime college averages. Recheck the page before answering because statistics change.

library_contact.title: General college contact
library_contact.answer: The official website footer lists +91 9848823332, info@srkrec.ac.in and the address SRKR Marg, China Amiram, Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh, India - 534204. For a specific service, prefer its dedicated office contact when published.

ece_labs.title: ECE laboratory facilities
ece_labs.answer: The official ECE facilities page describes eleven laboratories. Named examples include Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Analog Circuits, Microprocessors & Microcontrollers, Communication, VLSI Design, Digital Signal Processing, Microwave & Antennas, IoT, Project & Innovation, and Skill Development labs, along with a departmental library. This information is specific to ECE and should not be generalized to other departments.

admissions.title: Admissions information
admissions.answer: The official website provides separate Admission Procedure/Overview, Admission Brochure, Fee Structure and EAPCET Rank Cut-off pages. Admission routes, eligibility, seat categories, documents, fees and cut-offs can change by academic year. The chatbot should link to the current official page and avoid promising admission or quoting old cut-offs as current.

examinations.title: Examinations portal
examinations.answer: The SRKR site links to a separate examinations portal at srkrexams.in. Students should use the official examinations portal for current examination notices, timetables, results and examination-related services. The chatbot should not invent dates or results.

research.title: Research and innovation
research.answer: The official website has sections for Research & Development, Entrepreneurship Development, IPR Cell, Institution's Innovation Council, Centres of Excellence, research centres/resources, projects, publications, patents and MoUs. Direct users to the relevant official section for current opportunities, policies and contacts.

student_clubs.title: Student clubs and activities
student_clubs.answer: The official website provides dedicated Student Clubs and Sports sections under Life at SRKR. The chatbot should direct students to those live pages or the Student Affairs office for current club lists, joining procedures, event dates and eligibility.

sports.title: Sports facilities
sports.answer: SRKR's website provides a Sports section and the hostel page mentions a playground and indoor gaming facilities. For current team schedules, sports equipment access, coaching, events and facility rules, contact the Student Affairs or sports office.

wellbeing.title: Student well-being support
wellbeing.answer: The official site has a Well-Being section. For personal, medical, counselling or urgent safety support, students should contact the college's designated support office or emergency services directly; the chatbot should not invent confidential contact details.

ragging.title: Anti-ragging
ragging.answer: The official hostel page explicitly states that SRKR follows a no-ragging ethos. For reporting or current anti-ragging committee contacts and procedures, use the official college policies/committees pages or approach the college administration. Do not fabricate reporting channels.

faculty_directory.title: Faculty and leadership directory
faculty_directory.answer: The official Leadership Team page lists executive leadership, deans, department heads, programme coordinators and administrative roles. Because appointments may change, the chatbot should retrieve names and contacts from the live page rather than treating stored names as permanent.

fees.title: Tuition and other fees
fees.answer: The official SRKR website has a Fee Structure page. The chatbot should link users to the latest published fee structure and distinguish tuition, university/examination charges, hostel, transport and other charges where the official document does so. Do not estimate or reuse a previous year's amount as current.

academic_calendar.title: Academic calendar
academic_calendar.answer: The official website has an Academic Calendar page under Regulations & Curriculum. Students should consult the calendar for their programme/regulation and academic year. The chatbot should not invent semester start dates, holidays or examination windows.

general_unknown.title: Unknown or unverified information
general_unknown.answer: I could not verify that detail from the SRKR sources currently indexed. Please check the relevant official SRKR page or contact the college office/department. If you share your programme, branch, regulation and year/semester, I can help locate the correct academic resource.

institution_snapshot_2026.title: Institution snapshot as displayed on the official homepage
institution_snapshot_2026.answer: The SRKR homepage currently displays: established in 1980; NAAC A+ grade with CGPA 3.42 in Cycle II; six NBA-accredited programmes named as CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering; 415+ faculty; 160+ PhDs; 30,000+ graduates; 2,344+ placement offers so far for the 2025-26 batch; 2,900+ Scopus-indexed publications; 15,117+ Scopus citations; ₹12.5 crore in funded projects; 200+ published/granted patents; 65+ MOUs; and 16 supported start-ups. These are live homepage figures and may change. Always preserve the reporting date/batch and do not present them as timeless statistics.

accreditation.title: Accreditation and institutional recognition
accreditation.answer: The college profile states that SRKR has NAAC A+ accreditation with CGPA 3.42 in Cycle II. It identifies CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, Civil and Mechanical programmes as NBA-accredited. It also describes SRKR as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO) recognized by the Ministry of Science and Technology. Check the official profile for current accreditation validity and scope.

research_infrastructure.title: Research and innovation infrastructure
research_infrastructure.answer: The college profile describes recognized research centres, AICTE IDEA Lab, DST-FIST funding, MSME-backed incubation space and SIRO recognition. The homepage also displays funded projects, publications, citations, patents, MOUs and supported start-ups. For project funding, patents, research centres, incubation and collaboration details, consult the relevant current R&D/Innovation sections.

mechanical_department_profile.title: Mechanical Engineering department profile
mechanical_department_profile.answer: The official Mechanical department page describes Mechanical Engineering as one of SRKR's founding departments, established in 1980. It offers B.Tech, M.Tech in CAD/CAM and PhD/research opportunities. The page reports 40 faculty members, 12 laboratories, more than 160 computing systems/workstations, over 450 research papers, and a sanctioned B.Tech intake of 120 students annually. It describes recognition as a research centre by JNTUK and Andhra University. Staff counts and intake are time-sensitive and should be checked on the live page.

mechanical_labs.title: Mechanical Engineering laboratories
mechanical_labs.answer: The Mechanical department lists twelve laboratories: Engineering Workshop, Thermal Engineering, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulics, Strength of Materials, Manufacturing Processes, Metallurgy & Material Science, Heat Transfer, Industrial Engineering, CAD, CAM, Engineering Mechanics and Theory of Machines. Its facilities page describes CAD/CAM and CNC machining resources and software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks and ABAQUS. Check the department for current equipment access and lab schedules.

ece_department_labs_detailed.title: ECE laboratories
ece_department_labs_detailed.answer: The ECE facilities page lists Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Analog Circuits, Microprocessors & Microcontrollers, Communication, VLSI Design, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Microwave & Antennas, IoT, Project & Innovation, and Skill Development laboratories, plus a departmental library. The page describes eleven laboratories and highlights the VLSI Design Lab as a Centre of Excellence.

leadership_executive.title: Executive leadership
leadership_executive.answer: The official Leadership Team page currently lists Dr. M. Jagapathi Raju as Director, Dr. K.V. Murali Krishna Raju as Principal, and Mr. Ch. Dileep Chakravarthy as Chief Administrative Officer. These appointments can change; retrieve current names from the live page before answering.

leadership_deans.title: Academic and institutional deans
leadership_deans.answer: The current Leadership Team page lists Dr. V. Chandra Sekhar (Dean, Academics), Dr. T. Vamsi Nagaraju (Dean, Research and Development), Dr. K.R. Satyanarayana (Dean, Placements and Industry Relations), Dr. S. Rajesh (Dean, IQAC), Dr. G. Harish Kumar Varma (Dean, Student Affairs and Alumni), and Dr. B.S. Diwakar (Dean, Applied Sciences). Verify the live directory because responsibilities and names may change.

hod_contacts.title: Department head email contacts
hod_contacts.answer: The current Leadership Team page lists these department contacts: Civil – civil@srkrec.ac.in; CSE – cse@srkrec.ac.in; ECE – ece@srkrec.ac.in; EEE – eee@srkrec.ac.in; Mechanical – mech@srkrec.ac.in; IT – it@srkrec.ac.in; Management Studies – hod.bba@srkrec.ac.in; Mathematics – maths@srkrec.ac.in; Chemistry – chemistry@srkrec.ac.in; Physics – physics@srkrec.ac.in; English and Foreign Languages – english@srkrec.ac.in. Confirm the current HOD and email on the official directory.

programme_coordinator_contacts.title: Programme coordinator email contacts
programme_coordinator_contacts.answer: The current Leadership Team page lists programme contacts: CS & IT – csit@srkrec.ac.in; AI & ML – pc.aiml@srkrec.ac.in; AI & Data Science – hod.aids@srkrec.ac.in; CS & Business System – hod.csbs@srkrec.ac.in; CSE-IoT & Cyber Security – hod.cic@srkrec.ac.in; CS & Design – hod.csd@srkrec.ac.in. Verify the current coordinator and address on the official page.

student_clubs_technical.title: Technical and professional student clubs
student_clubs_technical.answer: The official Student Clubs page lists technical/professional groups including E-Mobility, Drone, Embedded and IoT, VLSI, AI, Networking and Cybersecurity, Quantum Technologies, Prompt Engineering, Deep Technology, Web Development, Coding, ACM, IEEE, IEI, ISTE, CSI, IGBC, IIPE and IETE. Their published focus areas include EVs, drones, embedded systems, semiconductor design, AI/ML, cybersecurity, quantum technologies, software development, programming, engineering and professional development. Check the clubs page for current membership and activities.

student_clubs_creative.title: Creative, cultural and communication clubs
student_clubs_creative.answer: The official Student Clubs page lists Content and Media, Fine Arts, Dance, LOLO (music), Theatre, Cine Club, Language Nest, Toastmasters and IKS. Their described activities include photography, videography, graphic design, drawing, painting, classical and contemporary dance, vocal/instrumental music, acting, short films, communication, public speaking, personality development and Indian knowledge systems.

student_clubs_service.title: Service and social-impact student groups
student_clubs_service.answer: The official Student Clubs page lists NSS, Women Empowerment Cell and Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (UBA). Published activity areas include community service, literacy, health and hygiene awareness, blood donation, environmental conservation, disaster management, women's leadership and empowerment, rural development, sanitation, digital literacy and sustainable village development.

sports_clubs.title: Sports teams and activities
sports_clubs.answer: The official Student Clubs page lists Badminton, Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Kabaddi and Athletics. It describes training/practice and tournaments or competitions. Check the Student Clubs/Sports pages or Student Affairs office for current schedules, team selection, coaching and facility access.

samagra_festival.title: SAMAGRA annual techno-cultural fest
samagra_festival.answer: SAMAGRA is described on the official Student Clubs page as a three-day flagship techno-cultural festival. It includes national-level technical competitions in multidisciplinary emerging areas, research conclaves, project expos, cultural events and annual-day celebrations, organized jointly by departments and student clubs. Dates and registration details should be checked from current announcements.

jaitra_sports_carnival.title: JAITRA annual sports carnival
jaitra_sports_carnival.answer: JAITRA is described as SRKR's annual national-level sports carnival, conducted annually during January. The official page says it attracts participants from engineering colleges and universities and features inter-collegiate tournaments and athletics. Check current announcements for the next event date, registration and participating sports.

hackathons_project_expos.title: Hackathons and project expos
hackathons_project_expos.answer: The official Student Clubs page says SRKR hosts departmental hackathons throughout the academic year, focused on technology, sustainability and domain-specific challenges. These provide opportunities for students to collaborate, build solutions, present projects and compete for recognition. Specific themes, eligibility, team size and dates depend on each announcement.

hostel_rules_and_support.title: Hostel safety and student support
hostel_rules_and_support.answer: The official hostel page says wardens attend to residents and regularly provide medical and other essential support. It states that the campus follows a no-ragging ethos and encourages hostel residents to use the gymnasium, playground and indoor gaming facilities. For curfew, leave, visitors, mess, room allocation, fees and disciplinary rules, consult the hostel office; do not infer rules that are not published.

transport_service.title: College bus service
transport_service.answer: SRKR operates a dedicated college bus fleet for students and staff commuting from Bhimavaram and surrounding towns/villages. The official transport page says the buses cover multiple rural and urban routes and aim to reach campus at least 15 minutes before classes and office hours. It does not mean every village is served; confirm route, stop, seat availability, fees and timings with the Transport Section.

campus_location_limits.title: Limitations of public campus map
campus_location_limits.answer: The Mapcarta campus map is based on OpenStreetMap and related public geographic data. It can help identify mapped outdoor features, but it does not guarantee the latest campus layout, internal building entrances, floor plans, room numbers or all department blocks. For precise navigation, ask the college reception, security desk or relevant department.

admissions_contact_path.title: Where to verify admission details
admissions_contact_path.answer: For admissions, use the official SRKR Admission Overview, Admission Procedure, Admission Brochure, Fee Structure and EAPCET rank cut-off sections linked from the college website. Admission eligibility, seat categories, counselling rounds, documents and fee amounts are academic-year dependent. The chatbot should state the relevant year and link the official notice instead of treating older details as current.

placement_contact_team.title: Placement team contacts
placement_contact_team.answer: The current placements team page lists Dean of Placements & Industry Relations Dr. K.R. Satyanarayana at krsn@srkrec.ac.in and 9704195376; Manager Corporate Relations G. Ashok Reddy at corporaterelations@srkrec.ac.in and 9440359517; and Manager International Affairs Baskar C at baskar.c@srkrec.ac.in and 9790997707. It lists the T&P office at U Block, with office hours Monday-Saturday, 9 AM-5 PM. Verify live before use.

placement_branch_coordinators.title: Department placement coordinators
placement_branch_coordinators.answer: The placements team page lists branch-level T&P coordinators and their contact details. Since individual assignments and personal contact details may change, the chatbot should link to the current official placements team page rather than store these details as permanent facts. For general placement queries, use dean.placements@srkrec.ac.in or the published Dean of Placements contact.

college_contact_channels.title: College contact channels
college_contact_channels.answer: The college homepage/footer provides general contact details, while individual service pages provide dedicated addresses for hostels, transport, placements and departments. Route the user to the office that handles their issue rather than always giving the main college number. Check the official contact page for the latest details.

library_resources.title: Library digital resources
library_resources.answer: The official library page lists electronic resources and databases including ScienceDirect, ASCE Library, IEEE Xplore, Springer, DELNET, J-Gate, N-LIST, NPTEL and Knimbus. Access conditions may differ by resource and may require campus network or institutional login. Students should use the library's official resource links or ask library staff about remote access.

library_services.title: Library services and spaces
library_services.answer: The library page describes RFID automation, reading and reference sections, book-bank services, a Digital Learning Centre, e-learning resources and catalogue search through OPAC. It also lists print journals and electronic journals. Current borrowing limits, opening hours, fines, membership and renewal rules should be confirmed with the library because these operational rules may change.

department_facilities_route.title: Finding department facilities
department_facilities_route.answer: Department-specific facilities are published on individual department pages. For example, the ECE page lists eleven laboratories and the Mechanical page lists twelve. Do not assume that one department's laboratory list applies to another branch. For branch-specific labs, projects, faculty, research and infrastructure, open the relevant department page from the official SRKR website.

academic_regulation_selection.title: How to choose the right regulation
academic_regulation_selection.answer: The syllabus directory contains multiple regulations because students from different admission batches may follow different curricula. Do not automatically choose the newest regulation. First identify the student's admission batch, programme/branch and year/semester, then match those details to the applicable official regulation. If uncertain, ask the academic section or department.

r23_btech_catalogue.title: R23 B.Tech syllabus coverage
r23_btech_catalogue.answer: The official syllabus directory lists R23 B.Tech syllabus resources for I, II, III and IV years across AIDS, AIML, CSIT, Civil, CSBS, CSD, CSE, CIC, ECE, EEE, IT and Mechanical. It also lists model papers, Open Electives I-IV, Honours and Minors. This catalogue does not itself contain the full subject names, credits, units or course outcomes; those must be extracted from the linked R23 PDFs.

r20_btech_catalogue.title: R20 B.Tech syllabus coverage
r20_btech_catalogue.answer: The official syllabus directory lists R20 B.Tech resources for I, II, III and IV years across AIDS, Civil, CSBS, CSD, CSE, CIC, ECE, EEE, IT and Mechanical, along with Honours, Minors and open electives. Students should verify whether R20 applies to their batch before using these documents.

r26_first_year_catalogue.title: R26 first-year B.Tech syllabus coverage
r26_first_year_catalogue.answer: The official directory lists R26 B.Tech first-year syllabus and model papers for AIDS, AIML, CSIT, Civil, CSBS, CSD, CSE, CIC, ECE, EEE, IT and Mechanical. The directory index does not provide all subject-level details in its listing; consult the corresponding R26 PDF.

r24_bba_catalogue.title: R24 BBA syllabus coverage
r24_bba_catalogue.answer: The official directory lists R24 BBA syllabus and model-paper resources for I, II and III years. Students should select the correct BBA year and the R24 document from the official syllabus directory.

r25_mtech_catalogue.title: R25 M.Tech syllabus coverage
r25_mtech_catalogue.answer: The official syllabus directory lists R25 M.Tech resources for specializations including Computer Science and Technology, Communication Systems, Power Systems and Automation, CAD/CAM, Information Technology and Structural Engineering. Confirm the exact specialization name and current availability from the official programme/admission pages.

events_and_annual_activities.title: Campus events and activities
events_and_annual_activities.answer: The Student Clubs page highlights SAMAGRA, JAITRA, NSS special camps, hackathons and project expos. Dates, registration links, eligibility, venues and schedules are event-specific. The chatbot should retrieve current event announcements rather than reuse old dates.
